description: Svenska kraftnät Data Service is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Svenska kraftnät (Swedish national grid operator). An open and free website with information on the Swedish electricity system: electricity production, procured volumes in the balancing markets and day-ahead market prices, as downloadable files and a technical interface. Coverage: Sweden, all four bidding areas. Formats and interfaces named: CSV, API. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the page says the data are unsuitable for operational decisions, network operations or time-critical functions and are meant for analysis, research and visualisation. It can support electricity system and market analysis for Sweden. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
